extraction.title: Moira dela Torre hits 11 million followers on Spotify | ABS-CBN Entertainment
extraction.description: OPM singer-songwriter Moira dela Torre now has 11 million followers on music streaming platform Spotify.
extraction.text: MANILA -- OPM singer-songwriter Moira dela Torre now has 11 million followers on music streaming platform Spotify. The "Tagpuan" hitmaker shared the newest milestone as "the most-followed Filipino soloist" on the platform via a social media post over the weekend. Dela Torre also known for her hits like "Malaya," "Paubaya," "Ikaw At Aiko," "Before It Sinks In" is currently gearing up for her fourth major concert billed as "Where It All Started" happening on October 4 at 8 p.m. at the Mall of Asia Arena. In her upcoming concert, apart from her hits, she is set to share direct personal disclosures on stage. Joining her in her concert as guests are Ogie Alcasid, Adie, Johnoy Danao, December Avenue, and surprise co-billing artists. Tickets are still available in other sections via ticketmaster.ph Moira dela Torre to stage major concert at MOA Arena
